**Dropnook 2.0.2** — the new donation link, and the guides brought up to date.

* **Donating:** the link in Drop's help, in all 17 languages, now goes to [paypal.me/dropnook](https://paypal.me/dropnook).
* **Guides:** the READMEs and dropnook.app now match 2.0.1:
  * when a renewed certificate is picked up;
  * what happens to uploads nobody continues, and to one that does not fit;
  * how long a text field can be;
  * how to move from 1.x straight to the `.env`.

Nothing to change on your side: *Check for Updates* → *Update*.
